sources.title: Product discovery
sources.text: Product discovery workshop. Our focus is a calmer onboarding experience for new teams. User interviews show that people struggle to find their first useful action. Prioritize a guided first board, contextual templates, and a simple invite flow. Success criteria: a team creates its first shared board within ten minutes. Open question: how should we measure activation across different team sizes? Before launch, validate the guided flow with five new teams. Assign an owner for accessibility and define a rollback plan.

sources.title: Q4 product roadmap
sources.text: Q4 product roadmap. Phase 1: synthesize research and align on the onboarding problem. Phase 2: prototype guided setup and test contextual templates with five teams. Phase 3: build invitations, instrument activation events, and check accessibility. Phase 4: launch to a pilot cohort, collect feedback, then expand. Dependencies: analytics event definitions, design signoff, and engineering capacity. Risks: onboarding scope creep and invitation permissions. Product team owns prioritization; engineering owns instrumentation.

sources.title: The next big idea
sources.text: Brainstorming for collaborative research. Ideas include source-linked AI summaries, grouping similar sticky notes, highlighting contradictory research, and publishing an approved roadmap to a Miro board. The highest priority is traceability: every AI answer must link back to original source material. Keep a human approval step before publishing any generated sticky notes. Explore a knowledge graph that connects documents to board themes.

sources.title: Customer interview insights
sources.text: Five customer interviews found three themes. Discovery: users lose context when switching between board notes and research documents. Trust: they want to inspect the exact excerpt behind an AI answer. Collaboration: people prefer a draft proposal that they can edit before it changes a shared board. Recommendations: unify sources, surface citations next to claims, and always preview outgoing board changes. Limitations: this is an exploratory sample of five teams; validate with a larger group before making broad claims.

sources.title: Discovery workshop notes
sources.text: Workshop decisions: build a single research workspace connecting Miro and Gemini. Import boards and text documents; chunk content with overlap and preserve source IDs. Retrieve relevant snippets before generation. Missing ideas include data retention policy, accessibility testing, source freshness indicators, and permission-aware search. Next steps: appoint workstream owners, review security boundaries, and agree acceptance criteria before implementation.

sources.title: Onboarding project brief
sources.text: The onboarding project helps new product teams reach a shared first board in under ten minutes. In scope: guided setup, contextual templates, invitations, accessibility and activation measurement. Out of scope: enterprise provisioning and billing changes. Delivery: research synthesis, prototype validation, implementation, and pilot. A release decision requires documented test outcomes, an identified owner, and a rollback plan.
